entries.reason: `IF WS-PTR = NULL`: LOAD PROGRAM('CALDTG') SET(WS-PTR) LENGTH(WS-LEN) of the defined CALDTG is the last command before it and completes NORMAL; IBM: SET(ptr-ref) is set to the address at which the program is loaded, so the pointer is never null after a NORMAL LOAD. The program takes no input and CALDTG is installed.

`IF WS-LEN > 0`: LOAD of the defined CALDTG completes NORMAL; IBM: LENGTH(data-area) is set to the length of the loaded program, which is above zero. The program takes no input and CALDTG is installed.
